description: This file contains the implementation of the HtmlEmailSender interface, providing methods to send HTML emails with template processing via FreeMarker, using JavaMailSender. It includes email configuration, template processing, and email message construction.

classes.name: HtmlEmailSenderImpl
classes.description: A class that implements the HtmlEmailSender interface, responsible for constructing and sending HTML emails with support for email templates and configurations.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Main method to send an email using the provided Email object, processing templates and setting email properties.

methods.name: getFreemarkerMailConfiguration
methods.description: Getter for the FreeMarker configuration used for template processing.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Getter for the EmailConfig object, containing custom email server settings.
